name: VA Unpinned Notification
description: Notifies when virtual appliance cluster component has been unpinned.
subject: $PRODUCT_NAME Notification: The pinned VA cluster component $processName $processVersion has expired. The VA cluster will be updated.
body:
Pinned VA cluster component expired

Hello,

The pinned version of a virtual appliance cluster component has expired. The latest VA updates will be pushed to the cluster.

Component: $processName

Pinned version: $processVersion

Thank you,
The $PRODUCT_NAME Team
